h: Dele Momodu takes a swipe at Wike over those 'inconsolable' about missing out on candidacy
p: Publisher Dele Momodu has reportedly said some people remain inconsolable because they did not get a party ticket, in a remark widely read as aimed at Nyesom Wike.
more: The comment adds to the exchange of words among political figures ahead of 2027.
Wike has not responded in the reports seen so far.
